raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) arrived with source_tz='UTC' timestamps, while every earlier batch is America/Chicago local time. Because the pipeline casts txn_ts without looking at source_tz, Chicago evening transactions (UTC 00:00-05:00) were shifted onto 2026-01-19 and the 2026-01-18 volume was understated; the per-row source_tz column lets us normalize these rows back to Chicago local time.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'America/Chicago' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE source_tz) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
